entries.title: Doo Doong Deung Jang! (두둥 등장)
entries.usedFor: TFT Mobile launch rap ad (Riot Korea)
entries.background: A short rap jingle that Riot Korea commissioned from rapper MUSHVENOM to advertise the March 2020 launch of Teamfight Tactics on mobile, which arrived together with the Galaxies set. The ad ran during LCK broadcasts, where its 'du-dung' hook turned into a running chat meme, and it started a series of MUSHVENOM songs for later sets. Riot's Latin American channel reposted it as 'Doo Doong Deung Jang!'.

entries.title: Face Your Fate (운명 앞에 위.풍.당.당.)
entries.usedFor: Fates (Set 4) launch music video, Riot Korea
entries.background: Riot Korea's second rap song with MUSHVENOM, released as a music video for the September 2020 launch of the Fates set. It swaps the mobile ad's catchphrase for a new 'wee-poong-dang-dang' chant and works in references to well-known League community memes. Riot's Russian channel also published a version with localised subtitles.

entries.usedFor: Reckoning (Set 5) Chaos Pengu anthem, Riot Korea

entries.title: 오손도손 (Osondoson)
entries.usedFor: Gizmos & Gadgets (Set 6) music video, Riot Korea
entries.background: A Riot Korea music video for the November 2021 launch of Gizmos & Gadgets, rapped by entertainer Haha and singer BIBI, the artists Riot Korea partnered with for the new set. The video gathers Pengu and chibi champions for a cosy get-together, which is what the title (roughly 'snug and friendly') describes.

entries.title: Sushi Shop (초밥집)
entries.usedFor: Neon Nights (Set 6.5) rap promo, Riot Korea
entries.background: A comedic rap video by the Korean parody-music group KillingBees (킬링벌's), released by Riot Korea for Neon Nights (Set 6.5) under the 'Drop the Villain' banner. It plays on the carousel's Korean nickname, the conveyor-belt sushi bar, and name-checks the set's newcomers such as Silco. KillingBees made a similar 'Drop The Champ' series for Wild Rift Korea.

entries.title: Dragon Drill (쥬래건의 땅)
entries.background: A drill-rap promo by rapper Northfacegawd (노페갓) that Riot Korea released for the June 2022 launch of Dragonlands. Its Korean title jokingly mixes up dinosaurs and dragons in a pun on 'the land of dragons', and Riot's English localisation of the video calls it 'Dragon Drill'.

entries.title: THE STAGE IS YOURS
entries.background: A Korean promotional song for Remix Rumble (Set 10), sung by the virtual K-pop artist APOKI and written, produced and mastered by D.June of VV Entertainment, which also made the video with Riot Korea. In it Pengu and Choncc invite APOKI onto the Remix Rumble stage; APOKI's own channel posted a teaser.

entries.title: Skyline of Dreams (Lofi Loop)
entries.usedFor: Star Guardian arena music, one-hour lofi loop
entries.background: A one-hour lofi loop of the music from Skyline of Dreams, a Star Guardian-themed Teamfight Tactics arena, posted on the official TFT channel as music to relax or study to. Unlike the later arena themes, it was never released as a separate track.

sources.title: Skyline of Dreams | Lofi Loop - Teamfight Tactics (YouTube)

entries.notes: Composer is not credited, so 'Riot Games Music' is used as in the catalog. The only official upload is the 60-minute loop 3GLt9HqsFYg (data/curated/video-classes/tft-1.json role 'related', not 'skip'; also in news.json); no Topic track, so no audioYoutubeId. Downloading the loop as a 1080p music video is heavy (3600 s).
